comment_queue.text: @carmenuyamane It's Ebimaru Ramen in Nishi-Kanda, about a 4-min walk from Jimbocho Station (exit A4) or Suidobashi Station (east exit). They can be closed on Mondays, so check before you go 🦞

@lanarocha You'll eat well! Easy wins when kids get hungry: konbini (7-Eleven, Lawson, FamilyMart) are on almost every corner with onigiri and sandwiches, department-store food floors (depachika) sell ready meals, and family restaurants like Gusto or Jonathan's have kids' menus. One heads-up: some tiny counter shops don't allow small kids, so keep a backup nearby 🐕
Lovely shots! If you're still in Tokyo: the main hall closes at 5pm, but the grounds stay open and the temple is lit up after sunset (until around 11pm), so it's much quieter at night 🏮
Your Akihabara day looks so fun! If you're there on a Sunday: Chuo-dori becomes a car-free pedestrian zone from 1-5pm (Oct-Mar, cancelled in bad weather) 🐕

comment_log.text: Love the Fujifilm tones! If you're back in Asakusa for lunch, Namiki Yabusoba (since 1913) is 2 min from the station, just note it's closed Thursdays.
comment_log.basis: shops.json Namiki Yabusoba: 2 min walk, closed Thursday; friend comment shows trip ongoing

comment_log.text: Great pond for reading! When you get hungry, Izuei Honten faces Shinobazu Pond and serves unaju (eel over rice) from ¥3,630, open 11:00-21:00 with an English menu.
comment_log.basis: shops.json Izuei Honten; post at Shinobazu Pond "read until I get hungry"

comment_log.text: Ueno in autumn looks lovely! If you're back in the park, Ueno Seiyoken inside it does hayashi rice and beef stew for lunch (closed Mondays).
comment_log.basis: shops.json Ueno Seiyoken; solo travel day 17 in Ueno

comment_log.text: Akihabara and Harajuku in one day! If you're back in Akihabara, Tsujita is 1 min from Suehirocho Station: rich tsukemen from ¥1,110, open every day (until 22:00 on weekdays).
comment_log.basis: shops.json Tsujita; first version said "open daily until 22:00" (weekends 21:30) → deleted and reposted

comment_log.text: Enjoy day 2! If you're near Ueno one evening, Daitoryo under the Ameyoko tracks serves skewers and stew until 23:30. Cash only, no booking needed.
Card hunting fuel: Shinpuku Saikan is 5 min from Akihabara Station, dark soy-sauce chuka soba from ¥880. Lunch 11:00-15:00, dinner from 17:30.
Lovely autumn walk! For a sweet stop after the park, Anmitsu Mihashi is 3 min from JR Ueno: cream anmitsu ¥760, open from 10:30.
Beautiful morning light! When lunch comes, Tonkatsu Yamabe is 1 min from Ueno-Hirokoji: a pork loin cutlet set for about ¥1,000, open from 11:00.
The egg sando is a must! For more snacks near Ueno, Niku no Oyama sells menchi-katsu from ¥150 at its standing counter, 2 min from Ueno Station.
